scripts.test: cargo test --locked && node --test tests/differential.mjs && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.bench:smoke: node bench/run.mjs repeats=1 warmup=5 samples=10 engines=original,js,wasm,packed-js out=work/bench-smoke
scripts.bench:full: node bench/run.mjs repeats=7 warmup=60 samples=180 engines=original,js,wasm,packed-js out=work/bench-full
scripts.bench:diagnostic: node bench/run.mjs repeats=1 warmup=30 samples=60 engines=original,js,wasm,packed-js timings=true gpu=true out=work/bench-diagnostic
scripts.bench:analyze: node bench/summarize.mjs bench/results/m2-full && node bench/analyze.mjs bench/results/m2-full
scripts.test:infra: node --test tests/infra.mjs tests/fox-analysis.mjs tests/server-port.mjs tests/profile-sources.mjs tests/editor-timing.mjs tests/editor-timing-phase.mjs tests/candidate-evidence.mjs tests/candidate-profile-analysis.mjs tests/candidate-profile-count-analysis.mjs tests/candidate-profile-session.mjs tests/candidate-profile-sources.mjs tests/archive-candidate-profile.mjs tests/editor-candidate-protocol.mjs tests/viewer-adapter.mjs tests/viewer-oracle.mjs tests/viewer-content.mjs tests/viewer-timing.mjs tests/viewer-timing-protocol.mjs tests/viewer-timing-session.mjs tests/viewer-profile-source-maps.mjs tests/viewer-profile-analysis-runs.mjs tests/viewer-network.mjs tests/viewer-transport-probe.mjs tests/viewer-transport-guard.mjs tests/editor-content-zip.mjs tests/editor-content.mjs
scripts.test:progress: node --test tests/progress-source.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_progress.py && node tests/progress.mjs
scripts.test:pipeline: node scripts/pipeline-audit.mjs --check && node --test tests/pipeline-oracle.mjs && node tests/pipeline-browser.mjs
scripts.test:status: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_status_site.py && node tests/status-site.mjs work/status-site
scripts.test:owned: node scripts/pipeline-audit.mjs --check && node --test tests/owned.mjs && node tests/owned-browser.mjs
scripts.test:fox: node scripts/fetch-fox.mjs && node tests/fox-rejections.mjs && node tests/fox-browser.mjs
